_comment: Story 052: the boss's animation on gankdroid's model (schema in ZombieAnimation.cs, ZombieAnimationConfig). Measured values seeded 2026-11-15 from production/qa/evidence/story-052-enemy-model-and-animations/rig-dump.txt (Tools > Last Dose > Dump Enemy Rig), to be confirmed by eye in play; every other value is the zombie's (enemies_zombie_anim.json).
_attack_clip_hit_time_note: enemy_attack_smg (0.167 s, 4 frames at 24 fps, upper body): the shot is at the start of the clip (both palms move fastest at 0.008 s); set to its first frame, 1/24 s.
_walk_reference_speed_note: enemy_walk_weak (1.208 s, in place): the lowest foot moves back 0.941 m in 1.175 s while planted, 0.80 m/s at the model's own size; the boss is scaled 1.3x (body_scale), so its feet cover 1.3x the ground per cycle: 0.80 x 1.3 = 1.04.
_run_reference_speed_note: enemy_run (0.792 s, in place): the lowest foot moves back 2.312 m in 0.759 s while planted, 3.05 m/s at the model's own size; x 1.3 for the boss's scale = 3.97.
